name: valkyrie
description: a Valkyrie (Fall from Heaven), a young blonde warrior maiden: long wavy golden hair under a silver helmet with two white feathered wings on its sides, a big blue eye, a silver breastplate with gold trim and silver pauldrons, a blue skirt with a white hem, a long blue cape, white fur-topped brown boots, and two large white feathered wings spread behind her shoulders; a long spear with a silver leaf-shaped point held upright in her LEFT hand (screen-right), and a round blue-and-white shield with a gold rim and a silver boss on her RIGHT arm (screen-left)
hands: the spear stays in her left hand on the screen-right side, held upright by the middle of the shaft with the point high, and the round blue-and-white shield stays strapped to her right arm on the screen-left side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-right, the spear is lifted beside the head with its silver point pointing up and back, wings half raised
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the spear hand behind the head and the spear's silver point hanging down behind the shoulders to the right, the round blue-and-white shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-left, the torso whips round, the spear arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the spear is level, its silver point thrusting to the left
strike.4: contact: spear arm fully extended toward the lower-left, the silver spear point stabbing down-left, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance, wings flared
strike.5: follow-through: the spear carries on down until its silver point nearly touches the ground at the lower-left, torso twisted, golden hair and blue cape trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the spear comes back up on the near side toward its upright ready angle, the round shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-left; head snaps back toward the upper-right, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, wings jolting open, both arms jerk outward (the spear arm thrown up and out to the right, the round blue-and-white shield flung out to the left)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-right, knees bent, the spear dipping, the round shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-right, body thrown back, the spear arm flung up, the round shield drooping, wings sagging
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the winged helmet droops, the spear lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the spear's silver point resting on the ground at the lower-left, the shield arm hanging, wings drooping
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-right, the spear slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, wings crumpling
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-left and head toward the upper-right, the winged helmet still on her head; the spear lies on the ground at the lower-left; the round blue-and-white shield lies flat beside her; the white wings and blue cape spread under her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the round shield rocks, the wings settle
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, white wings spread limp, the spear and the round shield on the ground beside her
